headline: SILVER SOARS 6% TO $85.50, TWO-MONTH HIGH, AS TRUMP KILLS IRAN PEACE DEAL
snippet: Silver surged over 6% to $85.50/oz Monday — its highest level in nearly two months — after President Trump dismissed Iran's latest ceasefire proposal as 'totally unacceptable,' reigniting safe-haven demand and dashing peace-deal optimism. With the Strait of Hormuz still blocked and weekend attacks threatening a fragile April ceasefire, silver is outpacing gold sharply on both geopolitical haven buying and persistent industrial-demand tailwinds.

headline: WALLBRIDGE OPENS DRAGONFLY CORRIDOR: MULTIPLE GOLD ZONES HIT IN FIRST MARTINIERE HOLES
snippet: Wallbridge Mining (TSX: WM) reported first results from its 17,000-metre Phase 1 drill campaign at the Martiniere gold project in Quebec, with the initial two holes intersecting multiple mineralized structures across significant widths in the Dragonfly corridor — including 4.53 g/t Au over 13.5m and 3.84 g/t Au over 3.0m. Four more Phase 1 holes are pending assay; the zone remains open laterally and at depth.

headline: APOLLO SILVER HITS 1,280 g/t Ag AT NEVADA'S CALICO MULE PROPERTY — PEA STUDY BEGINS Q3
snippet: Apollo Silver Corp (TSXV: APGO) reported rock samples grading up to 1,280 g/t Ag alongside gold and high-grade barite from the Mule property at its Calico project in California, with 245 rock samples and 893 soil samples collected across the project. The company expects drill permits in Q2 and first holes in Q3, with a Preliminary Economic Assessment also launching in Q3 2026.

headline: INDIA WON'T RAISE GOLD/SILVER DUTIES DESPITE MODI BOYCOTT CALL — WORLD'S LARGEST SILVER BUYER STAYS IN
snippet: India's government confirmed it has no plans to raise gold or silver import duties, a day after Prime Minister Modi urged citizens to stop buying gold due to the economic toll of the Iran war. The clarification matters: India is the world's second-largest gold consumer and largest silver consumer — keeping duty levels unchanged preserves a critical demand floor for both metals.

headline: COMEX PHYSICAL SILVER STRESS: SILVER ACT INTRODUCED IN CONGRESS AS DELIVERIES ESCALATE
snippet: Physical gold and silver deliveries at COMEX are accelerating, with registered silver vault coverage sitting below the 15% stress threshold for six consecutive months — triggering introduction of the SILVER Act (H.R. 8007) in Congress to address delivery-capacity constraints. Analysts warn the gap between paper market positioning and physical inventory availability is widening into a structural pressure point for the dollar.

headline: HONEY BADGER SILVER FINDS HIGH-GRADE GERMANIUM AT PRAIRIE CREEK — CRITICAL MINERAL BONUS FROM NWT BUY
snippet: Honey Badger Silver (TSXV: TUF) announced high-grade germanium potential at its Prairie Creek silver project in the Northwest Territories, uncovered through a new academic research partnership following its acquisition of Canadian Zinc. Germanium — a critical semiconductor mineral with export restrictions tightening globally — adds an unexpected critical-minerals layer to what was already Canada's largest undeveloped silver project.

headline: UR-ENERGY Q1: SHIRLEY BASIN URANIUM CAPTURE BEGINS, 417,000 LBS IN INVENTORY AT $70.98/LB REALIZED
snippet: Ur-Energy (NYSE: URG) reported Q1 2026 results showing Shirley Basin ISR operations began capturing uranium on resin in April 2026, with Q1 sales of 55,000 lbs at an average realized price of $70.98/lb against a cash cost of $37.51/lb. The company holds 417,231 lbs in finished inventory and is building toward full production at Shirley Basin as uranium demand from AI data centres and utilities accelerates.

headline: HERAEUS: SILVER MINE SUPPLY TO RISE 3% IN 2026 AS PRIMARY PRODUCERS RAMP — SIXTH YEAR OF DEMAND DEFICIT
snippet: Precious metals refiner Heraeus projects silver mine output will climb approximately 3% in 2026 as primary silver producers expand, but supply growth still falls well short of industrial demand — extending what The Silver Institute calls the sixth consecutive annual market deficit, projected at roughly 67 million ounces. Solar panel manufacturing and AI infrastructure are cited as the two fastest-growing new demand categories.

headline: COPPERNICO MAPS 4 KM COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY FOOTPRINT IN PERU — TIPICANCHA DRILL HOLES IMMINENT
snippet: Coppernico Metals (TSX: COPR) outlined a hydrothermal alteration footprint extending over 4 kilometres at the Tipicancha epithermal-porphyry copper-gold target within its 57,000-hectare Sombrero Project in Peru, with test pits returning up to 0.44% Cu across a continuous pyrite horizon. The company is advancing toward an initial drill program along the Andahuaylas-Yauri trend — one of the world's most prolific copper-gold belts.

headline: GOLDSEEK COT REPORT: GOLD AND SILVER SPECULATOR POSITIONING AFTER MAY'S PRECIOUS METALS VOLATILITY
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Commitments of Traders breakdown for the period ending May 6 examines managed-money positions in gold and silver futures alongside the US dollar index — a key data point for gauging whether the current precious metals rally is speculator-driven or reflects a durable shift in institutional positioning. COT data is closely watched by junior mining investors as a leading indicator of near-term metal price direction.
